discourse.excerpt: 28. The world must be made the abode of love. First, cultivate love for yourself; then, fill the village where you are with love; later, spread love to the district; and thus let it cover the entire world.
discourse.theme: Make the world the abode of love — begin with yourself, then your village, then let it cover the entire world.
discourse.title: Thirty-six Gems For You

reflection: Swami's birthday message still rings true: the world must be made the abode of love, and the expansion starts close to home — yourself, your street, your district, then the world. You cannot give what you do not cultivate. Today, do one small act of love that starts where you are: call someone you have not spoken to in a while, forgive a small slight, or simply smile at a stranger. Let love cover the world, beginning with your corner of it. (Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 2, 21 Nov 1961)
seva_nudge: Make your home or street a small abode of love today — bake or buy a treat for a neighbor, especially one who is elderly or alone.

video.title: Why Worldly Love Fails—and Divine Love Liberates | Sathya Sai Baba 14 July 1984
